name: Bound By Insanity
source:
The human brain is strange....everyone is different....and we all have our own definition for everything.

We feel things and turn them into concepts....shape them into words.......hoping that when we speak them, others will understand exactly what we mean.

So what if we apply this to something as subjective as love?

Could you blame me if I had an entirely different version of it in my head?

Am I in the wrong for acting accordingly to what I feel?...or are my actions justified if I'm being genuine?

Real life is ambiguous....even the good ones have darkness in their hearts....even monsters are capable of love.

And that is exactly what this story will show you.

Maybe you're a good person with a lack of common sense....or you're also a monster.

[From [url=https://lenaxiaos.itch.io/bound-by-insanity]itch.io[/url]]
